project_overview.what: Revenue-engine automation sold as a prescribed stack of AI systems, implemented then operated on our infrastructure for a recurring fee.
project_overview.why: Capital-efficient, high-retention business with better unit economics than an agency and lower capital requirements than SaaS; built on an acquisition engine that already works.
project_overview.end_state: A productized delivery business at $14m+ revenue with >70% recurring, low founder dependency, and a menu that stayed disciplined.
project_overview.current_summary: Planning only. Nothing built for an outside client. Extensive strategy work complete; the gating unknown is whether anyone buys.

current_focus: Run 10 paid audits and find out whether the pricing and the demand are real
immediate_next_steps: Define the day-one menu - every pricing question is downstream of it
Run 10 audits at $897; track conversion to a build and log what each prospect had already tried
Document every onboarding from client #1 so the eventual Head of Delivery does not arrive to an empty room
resume_here: Read docs/planning/DECISIONS.md first - it holds the reasoning behind every locked parameter. The live model is at https://lloyd-yip.github.io/revenueforge-model/. Nothing is built; the next real move is 10 audits, not more planning.
hard_constraints: This repo is documents only. Application code gets its own repo per born-standalone.
The initial sale is prescribed - no a la carte, no line items shown.
The recurring fee is never discounted. Discounts come out of the upfront only.
Value sets the price; complexity only decides whether an item goes on the menu at all.
known_issues: revenueforge-site and revenueforge-aeo-machine have no GitHub remote - local only, unbacked.
vast-sunspot/revenueforge/ originals are superseded but not deleted; the monorepo is under a migration freeze.
Neither revenueforge nor revenueforge-model is registered in monorepo-config/projects.json (registry is inside the frozen monorepo).
architecture_principles: Capacity decides starts; starts decide closes; closes decide audits. Never model forwards - it invents a queue.
Hours are not attention. Concurrent work-in-flight is its own constraint.
An efficiency curve is only a growth story if it also shortens duration.
Retention changes the multiple band, not just revenue - it is the single largest lever in the business.
